svg.text: Multimodal Generative RL Post-Training - built on veRL HybridFlow + vLLM-Omni rollout
L2 - Ray Diffusion Trainers (HybridFlow Control Flow)
Extends veRL Ray trainer for diffusion RL
Inherits veRL HybridFlow: single controller + swappable backends
Co-located sync + fully-async RL modes supported
L3 - Ray WorkerGroups (Diffusion + Omni Rollout + Reward)
FSDP2 / USP / TP parallelism for DiT backbones
Dedicated GPU pool - overlap with rollout/train
Model pipelines: Qwen-Image / Wan / BAGEL / Qwen3-Omni
Ray ResourcePool: train / rollout / reward GPU mapping
Co-located vs disaggregated rollout server modes
Controller RPC: split DataProto - dispatch diffusion workers - collect latents/images/rewards
L5 - Diffusion RL Algorithms & Model Families
FlowGRPO Main Loop (Diffusion RL Control Flow)
Reference: Qwen-Image OCR - ~25% higher throughput vs diffusers flow_grpo baseline
Step 1: DiffusionAgentLoop.generate - vLLM-Omni async denoising rollout (step-wise batching)
Step 2: Async reward pool scores images (OCR/VLM) - overlaps with next rollout batch
Step 3: compute_log_prob on denoising trajectory - per-step latent log_probs collected
Step 4: compute_advantages on controller - merge DiffusionOutput into DataProto
Step 5: update_actor via DiffusersFSDPEngine - sync LoRA weights back to vLLM-Omni server
Non-AR RL: rewards on generated images/video - not token-level text rewards
Rollout correction (experimental) improves diffusion RL stability under off-policy drift
vLLM-Omni Rollout Integration + Three Model Families
High-throughput async serving decoupled from FSDP training workers
Tokenize prompt + optional CFG negative prompt
Pre-release: stable core diffusion RL stack - expanding omni + unified model support
verl-project/verl-omni - NVIDIA CUDA + Ascend NPU - wandb/mlflow - multi-node Ray - Apache 2.0
Init path: Ray cluster - spawn train/rollout/reward pools - init vLLM-Omni async servers - load diffusion ckpt + LoRA
Step path: omni rollout - async reward - log_prob - advantages - FSDP update - LoRA sync to rollout server - repeat
Sources: verl-project/verl-omni - verl-omni.readthedocs.io - vllm-project blog 2026-05-14 - verl PR #5716 / Issue #4639
